description: Defines classes and functions for iterating and processing configuration values associated with build targets in the GN build system. Includes ConfigValuesIterator class, recursive writing functions, and related enums.

classes.name: ConfigValuesIterator
classes.description: An iterator to traverse all ConfigValues applying to a specific target, including the target's own config values and those from its configs.

methods.name: RecursiveTargetConfigToStream
methods.description: Writes all config values from a target and its configs to a stream, optionally skipping duplicates.

methods.name: RecursiveTargetConfigStringsToStream
methods.description: Outputs config values as strings with no transformation, handling duplicates based on configuration.
